assessment.summary: All four abstract declarations are valid; source, fidelity, compiler receipt and PF-CORE v2 binding match. Geometric realization is not formalized.

source.attribution: Historical Argus PF-CORE formalization using Mathlib; current contribution is reproduction and assessment.

claims.quantifiers: Every group G, every endomorphism sigma:G->*G, every b,g:G.
claims.conclusion: sigma(g)^-1 * sigma(b) * sigma(sigma(g)) = sigma(g^-1 * b * sigma(g))

claims.quantifiers: Every pair of groups G,H, homomorphisms sigma:G->*G, tau:H->*H, rho:G->*H, and b,g:G.
claims.conclusion: rho(sigma(g))^-1 * rho(sigma(b)) * tau(rho(sigma(g))) = rho(sigma(g^-1 * b * sigma(g)))
claims.reason: Use compatibility at sigma(g), then homomorphism laws.

claims.quantifiers: Every pair of groups G,H, homomorphism rho:G->*H, and z:G.
Every topological space X, index type I, value types A(i), fixed maps d_i:X->A(i), specified zero_i, and common predicate good.
hypotheses: For every x:X there exists good y in connectedComponent(x)
At every good y, for every i:I, d_i(y)=zero_i
claims.conclusion: For every i:I and x:X, d_i(x)=zero_i
claims.reason: A locally constant map is constant on a preconnected connected component.

supported_scope: Universal group identities, without finiteness or prime restrictions and without assuming sigma invertible.
Central preimage under an explicitly injective homomorphism.
Conditional simultaneous propagation of a fixed indexed family from a common good-point set.
Reuse of one historical PF-CORE v2 certificate; duplicate files and submission handle are not extra proofs.
limitations: No abelian varieties, crystalline representations, local Shimura varieties, tensor torsors, admissible filtrations or universal quasi-isogenies are constructed.
Geometric local constancy, fixed-type interpretation of discrepancies, component coverage and simultaneous good-point values remain external obligations.
No scalar-center or group-scheme centrality identification is formalized.
Historical certificate does not hash imported Mathlib dependencies; current workspace manifest identifies its declared revision, not a separately pinned installed tree; the stdin run is supplemental.
Axiom-audit success is not a claim that transitive dependencies use no standard foundational axioms.
No certification or refutation of PF-REALIZATION or the surrounding manuscript.
